_comment: Creature Burn (2026-11-20, Stage 2 batch 1). Keldon Marauders' VANISHING 2 + leave trigger, end to end in
the real game: it is summoning sick on turn 3 (cannot attack) holding its LAST time counter, the opponent
is at 1 and we have nothing else. Turn 4's upkeep removes the last counter, the Marauders is sacrificed
(CR 702.63a) and its 'leaves the battlefield: 1 damage' kills the opponent IN THE UPKEEP -- a turn-4 win.
Without vanishing the 3/3 would attack on turn 4 anyway (1 - 3 = -2), so the fixture also asserts the
opponent ENDS on exactly 0: the game ended in the upkeep, before any combat.
